title: Not indented
prompt: The print line belongs inside solve, but it is not indented, so Godot does not know it is part of the function. Fix it so the robot prints "Beep".
hints: Everything inside a function is indented one level with a tab.
The error mentions an expected indented block.
Put a tab in front of the print line.

docs.name: The error panel
docs.what: Godot's message plus the line it happened on, counted from the top of your code.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
